top_categories.workout_context: JUST.GRAVEL's UK Lake District, British gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 28 miles.
143ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At JUST.GRAVEL, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Race-pace efforts that mimic JUST.GRAVEL's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
Varied gradients on uK Lake District gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of JUST.GRAVEL. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At JUST.GRAVEL, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Smooth pedaling at 28 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
When someone attacks on uK Lake District gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Low-cadence force work for 4,000ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on uK Lake District gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Standard hydration and fueling. One bottle per hour minimum. Gel or bar every 45 minutes at race intensity.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at JUST.GRAVEL requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on uk lake district gravel to build confidence. Expect: uk lake district, british gravel, uk.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 28 miles of uk lake district gravel in Southern Lake District, UK.
